title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Desk Reference: Accounts and Members a Light May Be Billed To
content:
Under **Area and Security Lighting Rental**, a light is always billed on one of the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule accounts. This desk reference lists, for every fixture, the rate schedules a billing service account may be on, the kinds of member who may rent, whether the billing account must be active, and the most rental lights billed on one service account.

## Reference table

| Fixture | Rate schedules a light may be billed on | Member types that may rent | Billing service account must be active | Most rental lights billed on one service account |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | All seven schedules listed below | All five types listed below | Yes | 6 |
| LED 70W Area Light | All seven schedules listed below | All five types listed below | Yes | 6 |
| LED 110W Flood Light | All seven schedules listed below | All five types listed below | Yes | 6 |
| LED 150W Flood Light | All seven schedules listed below | All five types listed below | Yes | 6 |
| HPS 100W Security Light | All seven schedules listed below | All five types listed below | Yes | 6 |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | All seven schedules listed below | All five types listed below | Yes | 6 |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | All seven schedules listed below | All five types listed below | Yes | 6 |

**Rate schedules a light may be billed on** (the same list for every fixture):

1. Schedule R Residential Service
2. Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service
3. Schedule FH Farm and Home Service
4. Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service
5. Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service
6. Schedule IR Irrigation Service
7. Schedule LP Large Power Service

**Member types that may rent a light** (the same list for every fixture): individual, joint, business, nonprofit and government members.

## Points of reading

- The rate schedule looked at is the schedule of the service account the light is billed on, not that of any other account the member holds.
- The member type looked at is the member type on the member's record.
- The limit of 6 lights is counted on one service account; it is the same figure for every fixture.
